note: Inherent (post-repair) diminished value. First-party = your own collision/comprehensive coverage; third-party = claim against the at-fault driver. Summarised from the cases cited; most rulings turn on standard "repair or replace" policy wording, and many policies now exclude diminished value expressly.

sources.label: Matthiesen, Wickert & Lehrer, Diminution in Value Cases in All 50 States (updated March 16, 2022)
Journal of Insurance Regulation (NAIC), Automobile Diminished Value Claims (2023)

AL.first_party_note: Pritchett v. State Farm, 834 So.2d 785 (Ala. Civ. App. 2002): "repair or replace" pays repairs only.
AL.third_party_note: No appellate decision found allowing post-repair diminished value.

AK.first_party_note: No Alaska decision on auto policies.
AK.third_party_note: No direct ruling; Willett v. State, 826 P.2d 1142 (Alaska 1992) cites the Restatement rule that allows it.

AZ.first_party_note: Johnson v. State Farm, 754 P.2d 330 (Ariz. Ct. App. 1988).
AZ.third_party_note: Farmers Ins. Co. v. R.B.L. Inv. Co., 675 P.2d 1381 (Ariz. Ct. App. 1983); Oliver v. Henry, 260 P.3d 314 (Ariz. Ct. App. 2011): repair cost plus remaining loss in value.

AR.first_party_note: No ruling on auto policy wording.
AR.third_party_note: MFA Ins. Co. v. Citizens Nat. Bank, 545 S.W.2d 70 (Ark. 1977): if repairs don't restore value, the before-and-after difference.

CA.first_party_note: Ray v. Farmers Ins. Exch., 200 Cal. App. 3d 1411 (1988): a proper repair ends the insurer's duty.
CA.third_party_note: California jury instruction CACI 3903J allows the post-repair loss in value plus repair cost, up to the pre-accident value.

CO.first_party_note: Hyden v. Farmers Ins. Exch., 20 P.3d 1222 (Colo. App. 2000) says "like kind and quality" means similar in function and value; no ruling on post-repair diminished value.

CT.third_party_note: Littlejohn v. Elionsky, 36 A.2d 52 (Conn. 1944); Cassella v. Lenches (2010): repair cost plus remaining loss in value.

DE.first_party_note: O'Brien v. Progressive N. Ins. Co., 785 A.2d 281 (Del. 2001).
DE.third_party_note: No decision found on post-repair diminished value.

DC.third_party_note: American Service Center Assocs. v. Helton, 867 A.2d 235 (D.C. 2005): repair cost plus remaining loss in value, up to the total loss in value.

FL.first_party_note: Siegle v. Progressive Consumers Ins. Co., 819 So.2d 732 (Fla. 2002).
FL.third_party_note: McHale v. Farm Bureau Mut. Ins. Co., 409 So.2d 238 (Fla. 3d DCA 1982).

GA.first_party_note: State Farm v. Mabry, 556 S.E.2d 114 (Ga. 2001): insurers must assess and pay diminished value on physical damage claims under policies like State Farm's.
GA.third_party_note: Perma Ad Ideas v. Mayville, 282 S.E.2d 128 (Ga. Ct. App. 1981).

HI.third_party_note: No decision found on post-repair diminished value.

ID.third_party_note: No decision found on post-repair diminished value.

IL.first_party_note: Sims v. Allstate Ins. Co., 851 N.E.2d 701 (Ill. App. Ct. 2006).
IL.third_party_note: Trailmobile Div. v. Higgs, 297 N.E.2d 598 (Ill. App. Ct. 1973).

IN.first_party_note: Allgood v. Meridian Sec. Ins. Co., 836 N.E.2d 243 (Ind. 2005).
IN.third_party_note: Wiese-GMC, Inc. v. Wells, 626 N.E.2d 595 (Ind. Ct. App. 1993). Also owed under uninsured/underinsured motorist coverage: Dunn v. Meridian Mut. Ins. Co., 836 N.E.2d 249 (Ind. 2005).

IA.first_party_note: No ruling on auto policy wording.
IA.third_party_note: Hawkeye Motors v. McDowell, 541 N.W.2d 914 (Iowa Ct. App. 1995), if proven with evidence.

KS.first_party_note: No ruling on personal auto policy wording.

KY.first_party_note: Tomes v. Nationwide Ins. Co., 825 S.W.2d 284 (Ky. Ct. App. 1991).
KY.third_party_note: Muncie v. Wiesemann, 548 S.W.3d 877 (Ky. Ct. App. 2018); Conrad v. Shrout (Ky. Ct. App. 2018).

LA.first_party_note: Campbell v. Markel Am. Ins. Co., 822 So.2d 617 (La. Ct. App. 2001); Townsend v. State Farm, 793 So.2d 473 (La. Ct. App. 2001).
LA.third_party_note: By statute, La. R.S. 9:2800.17, up to the vehicle's pre-accident value.

ME.first_party_note: Hall v. Acadia Ins. Co., 801 A.2d 993 (Me. 2002).
ME.third_party_note: No decision found on post-repair diminished value.

MD.third_party_note: Fred Frederick Motors v. Krause, 277 A.2d 464 (Md. Ct. Spec. App. 1971).

MA.first_party_note: Given v. Commerce Ins. Co., 440 Mass. 207 (2003); Division of Insurance advisory opinion (May 2002): the standard policy doesn't cover it.
MA.third_party_note: McGilloway v. Safety Ins. Co., 174 N.E.3d 1191 (Mass. 2021): owed under Part 4 of the standard policy.

MI.first_party_note: Driscoll v. State Farm, 227 F. Supp. 2d 696 (E.D. Mich. 2002).
MI.third_party_note: Car damage claims against the at-fault driver are limited to the $3,000 mini-tort (MCL 500.3135(3)(e)); no decision found on diminished value inside it.

MN.first_party_note: Only an old ruling allowing it (Ciresi v. Globe & Rutgers, 244 N.W. 688 (Minn. 1932)); modern policies untested.
MN.third_party_note: No decision found on post-repair diminished value.

MS.first_party_note: Older rulings allowed it (Potomac Ins. Co. v. Wilkinson, 57 So.2d 158 (Miss. 1952)); modern policy wording untested.
MS.third_party_note: Thomas v. Global Boat Builders, 482 So.2d 1112 (Miss. 1986), with proper proof.

MO.first_party_note: Lupo v. Shelter Mut. Ins. Co., 70 S.W.3d 16 (Mo. Ct. App. 2002), where the policy is clear; if repairs fall short of restoring value, Williams v. Farm Bureau, 299 S.W.2d 587 (Mo. Ct. App. 1957).
MO.third_party_note: Rook v. John F. Oliver Trucking, 556 S.W.2d 200 (Mo. Ct. App. 1977).

MT.first_party_note: Eby v. Foremost Ins. Co., 374 P.2d 857 (Mont. 1962) suggests yes; the Supreme Court called it open in Hop v. Safeco, 261 P.3d 981 (Mont. 2011).

NE.third_party_note: Chlopek v. Schmall, 396 N.W.2d 103 (Neb. 1986): if the car is repaired, the measure is repair cost and loss of use; lost market value only if not repaired.

NV.first_party_note: Nev. Admin. Code 686A.680 requires only restoring the car to its condition before the loss.
NV.third_party_note: No decision found on post-repair diminished value.

NH.third_party_note: No decision found on post-repair diminished value.

NJ.first_party_note: Kieffer v. High Point Ins. Co., 25 A.3d 1206 (N.J. Super. Ct. App. Div. 2011), where the policy excludes it.
NJ.third_party_note: Fanfarillo v. East End Motor Co., 411 A.2d 1167 (N.J. Super. Ct. App. Div. 1980).

NM.first_party_note: Davis v. Farmers Ins. Co. of Ariz., 142 P.3d 17 (N.M. Ct. App. 2006).
NM.third_party_note: Hubbard v. Albuquerque Truck Ctr., 958 P.2d 111 (N.M. Ct. App. 1998).

NY.first_party_note: Only an old theft-claim ruling (Edwards v. Maryland Motor Car Ins. Co., 1922).
NY.third_party_note: Mostly for new, rare or appreciating cars: Rosenfield v. Choberka, 529 N.Y.S.2d 455 (1988); Parkoff v. Stavsky (App. Div. 2013).

NC.first_party_note: No ruling that standard collision coverage pays it.
NC.third_party_note: Measured as the before-and-after difference in value (DeLaney v. Henderson-Gilmer, 135 S.E. 791 (N.C. 1926)). Liability policies must offer appraisal when you and the insurer are more than $2,000 or 25% apart on it (N.C.G.S. 20-279.21(d1)); a release for repairs doesn't bar a diminished value claim made within 30 days after repair (11 NCAC 04.0421).

ND.third_party_note: By statute the measure is presumed to be repair cost plus loss of use (N.D.C.C. 32-03-09.1); value loss only if repair is impossible or impracticable.

OH.third_party_note: Rakich v. Anthem, 875 N.E.2d 993 (Ohio Ct. App. 2007); State Farm v. Cheeks (Ohio Ct. App. 2014).

OK.first_party_note: Phoenix Ins. Co. v. Diffie, 270 P.2d 634 (Okla. 1954) used the before-and-after value measure; modern policies untested.

OR.first_party_note: Gonzales v. Farmers Ins. Co. of Or., 196 P.3d 1 (Or. 2008): if repair can't restore the car to its pre-loss condition, the remaining loss in value is covered.
OR.third_party_note: EAM Advertising Agency v. Helies, 954 P.2d 812 (Or. Ct. App. 1998), with proof.

PA.first_party_note: Lobozzo v. Adam Eidemiller, Inc., 263 A.2d 432 (Pa. 1970): payment for diminished value is not something the public can reasonably expect.
PA.third_party_note: Holt v. Pariser, 54 A.2d 89 (Pa. Super. Ct. 1947).

RI.first_party_note: Cazabat v. Metropolitan (R.I. Super. Ct. 2000): the policy wording was ambiguous, a question for a jury.
RI.third_party_note: No decision found; Rhode Island's appraisal law (R.I. Gen. Laws 27-10.4-1) lets a claimant dispute the amount of loss.

SD.first_party_note: Culhane v. Western Nat'l Mut. Ins. Co., 704 N.W.2d 287 (S.D. 2005).
SD.third_party_note: No decision found on post-repair diminished value.

TN.first_party_note: Black v. State Farm, 101 S.W.3d 427 (Tenn. Ct. App. 2002).
TN.third_party_note: Repair cost or the before-and-after difference, not both; post-repair loss not clearly recognised (GEICO v. Bloodworth, Tenn. Ct. App. 2007).

TX.first_party_note: American Mfrs. Mut. Ins. Co. v. Schaefer, 124 S.W.3d 154 (Tex. 2003); TDI Bulletin B-0027-00.
TX.third_party_note: TDI Bulletin B-0027-00 says a liability insurer may owe a third-party claimant the loss of market value even after a complete repair; courts allow repair cost or value loss without double recovery.

VT.first_party_note: Vermont Insurance Bulletin 164 (2011): absent specific policy language to the contrary, the policy must pay diminished value.

WA.first_party_note: Moeller v. Farmers Ins. Co. of Wash., 267 P.3d 998 (Wash. 2011): "repair or replace" covers diminished value unless the policy clearly excludes it.
WA.third_party_note: The pattern jury instruction uses the lesser of repair cost or the before-and-after difference; no decision on post-repair loss.

WV.first_party_note: No authority for first-party claims (Insurance Commissioner informational letters, 2001).
WV.third_party_note: Only with structural damage on a car of significant value: Ellis v. King, 400 S.E.2d 235 (W. Va. 1990); Brooks v. City of Huntington, 768 S.E.2d 97 (W. Va. 2014).

WI.first_party_note: Wildin v. American Family, 638 N.W.2d 87 (Wis. Ct. App. 2001).
WI.third_party_note: Hellenbrand v. Hilliard, 687 N.W.2d 37 (Wis. Ct. App. 2004), if repairs didn't restore the value.

WY.third_party_note: No decision found on post-repair diminished value.
